meta.metric: Years from a BCI modality's first pivotal preclinical animal demonstration to its first-in-human implant. Most entries are nonhuman-primate; the animal model is recorded per entry (Synchron's pivotal preclinical work was in sheep).
meta.provenanceQuery: per-modality: first pivotal preclinical animal demonstration → first-in-human implant
meta.curationNote: Curated and human-reviewable. Small sample by design: we count MODALITIES, not companies, and only include a modality when both dates carry a primary source. Paradromics (Connexus) is omitted for now because its multi-year sheep preclinical work has no single clean 'first demonstration' date; its first-in-human was June 2025.
